description: One two-sentence horror story, in English or Spanish, by theme: domestic, technological, cosmic or folk. Returned SPLIT into setup and payoff as well as joined, so a narrating agent can deliver the first line, pause, and then land the second. Takes parameters, returns an id to avoid repeats, and accepts a seed for a reproducible answer. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

exclude.description: Ids already seen, comma-separated in a GET.

seed.description: Same seed always returns the same story.

theme.description: domestic | technological | cosmic | folk. Omit for any.

name: content_horror_story
title: Two-sentence horror story
